label: Sample rate
description: Audio samples per second; keep 16000 unless a support doc says otherwise.

label: Channels
description: Mono or stereo capture; keep 1 for dictation.

label: Encoding
description: Raw audio format sent to the provider; keep linear16.

label: Smart format
description: Provider formats dates, times, and numbers nicely on its own.

label: Punctuation
description: Provider inserts periods, commas, and question marks for you.

label: Interim results
description: Shows live partial words while you are still speaking.

label: Endpointing ms
description: Silence length before the service decides a phrase has ended.

label: Utterance end ms
description: Silence length before a whole thought is marked finished.

label: VAD speech events
description: Provider signals when it hears speech start and stop.

label: Include provider filler words
description: Keeps ums and uhs in the transcript instead of dropping them.

label: Dictation mode
description: Say punctuation aloud, like 'comma', and get the symbol.

label: Numerals
description: Writes numbers as digits (3) instead of words (three).

label: Deepgram MIP opt-out
description: Keeps your audio out of Deepgram's improvement program; leave on for privacy.

label: Auto Cleanup
description: How much tidying your words get. High removes ums and stumbles; None keeps everything.

label: Censor profanity
description: Replaces swear words with asterisks in your transcripts.

label: Smart formatting: structure every dictation
description: Automatically adds punctuation, capitals, and lists to everything you dictate.

label: Protect numbers, links, quotes, and intent during AI cleanup
description: Stops AI cleanup from ever changing numbers, links, quotes, or your meaning.

label: Formatting engine
description: Auto picks the best available. AI uses your AI provider. Built-in rules work offline. Off turns formatting off.

label: Save local transcript history
description: Keeps a private copy of your dictations on this computer; off keeps no record.

label: History limit
description: Most dictations kept in history; 0 means keep everything.

label: Redact emails, phone numbers, cards, SSNs before pasting
description: Blanks out personal details before text lands anywhere; use for sensitive work.

label: Paste method
description: How text lands in your app. Auto works nearly everywhere; try another if pasting misbehaves.

label: Typing interval ms
description: Delay between typed characters in typing mode; raise it if letters go missing.

label: Clipboard paste delay ms
description: Small wait before pasting; raise it if slow apps miss the paste.

label: Whisper-quiet mode (extra gain for soft speech)
description: Extra volume boost for speaking softly, like in a shared office.

label: Quiet mode boost
description: How much extra loudness whisper-quiet mode adds.

label: AI rewrite provider
description: Which AI powers rewrites. None turns AI off; Ollama runs free on your computer.

label: Formatting time budget ms
description: Longest the AI may spend formatting before built-in rules take over.

label: Translate to
description: The language used when you run a translate transform.

label: Enable automatic translation
description: Used with Auto-translate every dictation. Manual translation is always available after local setup.

label: Auto-translate every dictation
description: Everything you dictate is translated before it is pasted.

label: Preserve line breaks
description: Check the line-break count and keep surrounding spacing. Protected numbers and links are always checked.

label: Enable local control API for automations (127.0.0.1 only)
description: Lets programs on this computer control Talk DAT!; leave off unless you automate.

label: Your name
description: Home greets you by this name. Leave it blank to be greeted without one.

label: Open Home at launch
description: Off means Talk DAT starts straight to the Pill, with no window.

label: Update channel
description: Stable gets tested releases. Beta gets new features earlier, with more rough edges.

label: Reduce motion (skip pill animations)
description: Turns animations off; good if motion distracts you or the PC is slow.

label: Pill position
description: Which screen edge the pill sits on.

label: Appear on the monitor I'm using (follow the active window)
description: The pill follows you to whichever monitor you are working on.

label: Play start and stop sounds
description: A soft sound when recording starts and ends; turn off for silence.

label: Auto paste transcript
description: Types your words into the app you are using; off means copy only.

label: Smart leading space
description: Adds a space before pasted text when needed so words never stick together.

label: Tail capture ms
description: Extra listening after you release the key so your last word is not cut off.

label: Minimum capture ms
description: Shortest recording that counts; ignores accidental key taps.

label: Hold debounce ms
description: Ignores tiny accidental key releases while you hold to talk.

label: Hands-free max seconds
description: Longest a hands-free session can run before stopping itself.

label: Hands-free no speech
description: Stops hands-free if you never start speaking within this many seconds.

label: Hands-free silence
description: Stops hands-free after this many seconds of silence.

label: Hold max seconds
description: Longest a hold-to-talk session can run before stopping itself.

label: Hold no speech
description: Stops a hold session if no speech is heard for this long.

label: Hold silence
description: Stops a hold session after this much silence.

label: Keep your previous clipboard after pasting (off = keep the dictation on the clipboard)
description: Puts whatever you copied earlier back on the clipboard after your words paste.

label: Spoken press-enter command
description: Say 'press enter' at the end and the app sends the message for you.

label: Mute speaker output while recording
description: Silences your speakers while you talk so music is not transcribed.

label: Retry failed capture from local audio
description: If transcription fails, tries again from the saved recording so nothing is lost.

label: Protected session limit (minimum 5)
description: How many recent recordings to keep for recovery; at least five.

label: Check for updates on start
description: Looks for new versions each time the app opens; turn off to skip.

label: Auto-download update installer when a new release exists
description: Fetches updates in the background so installing later takes seconds.

label: Show overlay on start
description: Shows the pill as soon as the app opens; off hides it until needed.

label: Opacity
description: How solid the floating pill looks; lower is more see-through.

label: Hover fade delay ms
description: How long your mouse hovers before the pill fades out of the way.

label: Hover fade opacity
description: How faint the pill becomes while your mouse is over it.

label: Active pill width
description: Pill width while dictating; enlarge if it is hard to see.

label: Active pill height
description: Pill height while dictating; enlarge if it is hard to see.

label: Active window width
description: Width of the pill's window while active; usually leave alone.

label: Active window height
description: Height of the pill's window while active; usually leave alone.

label: Resting width
description: Pill width when idle; smaller stays further out of your way.

label: Resting height
description: Pill height when idle; smaller stays further out of your way.

label: Bottom margin
description: Gap between the pill and the edge of your screen.

label: Active frame ms
description: Animation refresh while dictating; higher numbers use less computer power.

label: Idle frame ms
description: Animation refresh while idle; higher numbers use less computer power.

label: Resize frame ms
description: Speed of each step when the pill grows or shrinks.

label: Resize steps
description: How many steps the grow-and-shrink animation takes; more looks smoother.

label: Active loop seconds
description: How long one cycle of the dictating animation lasts.

label: Idle loop seconds
description: How long one cycle of the idle animation lasts.

label: Result hold ms
description: How long finished text stays shown on the pill.

label: Error hold ms
description: How long error messages stay visible on the pill.

label: Wave loop start
description: Where the wave animation begins its repeat; purely cosmetic.

label: Wave loop end
description: Where the wave animation ends its repeat; purely cosmetic.

label: Always same bottom position
description: Keeps the pill anchored to one spot instead of remembering where you dragged it.

label: Do not steal focus
description: Stops the pill taking the keyboard away from the app you are typing in.

label: Hide pill over fullscreen media
description: Hides the pill during fullscreen video or games.

label: Show pill while dictating over fullscreen apps
description: Brings the pill back while you are actually speaking, even in fullscreen.

label: Fullscreen check ms
description: How often it checks for fullscreen apps; lower reacts faster.

label: Enable transforms (polish, tone, list)
description: Turns on the rewrite tools like Polish and Turn to list.

label: History storage
description: Plain text file or a searchable local database for your history.

label: Activation sound
description: The sound played when recording starts; preview and pick your favorite.

label: Release sound
description: The sound played when recording stops; preview and pick your favorite.

label: Microphone
description: Follow your system default or choose a microphone. Refresh after connecting a new device.

label: Wake word
description: Optional local listening on your selected microphone. Pause stops it; after Panic Stop, switch this off and on to resume. Requires compatible model files already on this computer.

label: Wake-word model
description: Installed wake model name or local ONNX path, with its required inference files. Nothing downloads automatically. Use a model licensed for your intended use.

label: Enable installed plugins
description: Runs local Python extensions you trust. They can access files and the network as your account. Failed or slow filters keep the preceding text. Save your choice before reloading.

label: Keep speech and finishing on this computer
description: Your audio and the text you dictate stay on this computer. When enabled, this takes priority over provider choices.

label: Share anonymous usage counts
description: First open, first dictation, still in use, day 7. Never your audio or text.

label: Download the selected local speech model
Personal words
description: Separate names and terms with commas or new lines. For pronunciation training and suggested words, open Words & Phrases.

label: Spelling replacements
description: Edit the existing structured entries as JSON. Changes are checked before saving.

label: Voice snippets
description: Edit the existing structured entries as JSON. Changes are checked before saving.

label: Custom rewrites
description: Edit the existing structured entries as JSON. Changes are checked before saving.

label: Extra Deepgram options
description: Edit the existing structured entries as JSON. Changes are checked before saving.

label: Translation glossary
description: Add preferred source terms and translations. Existing extra entry details are kept.
